simple.meaning: נְבִזְבָּה (nᵉbizbâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a largess.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְבִזְבָּה (H5023) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 2:6, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְבִזְבָּה (H5023) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נְבִזְבָּה (H5023) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נְבִזְבָּה (nᵉbizbâh) / H5023 is traced through Daniel 2:6, Daniel 5:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
